title: Allocator-war lead acquisition execution Wave 24 source plan
purpose: Bind every Wave 23 lead packet to a bounded official-first source set and an explicit acquisition disposition before writing packet-specific acquisition ledgers. The plan preserves unavailable, excluded, null, refused, and gate-unspecified states and creates no evidentiary adjudication, finding, graph effect, or publication authority.

packet_plans.coverage_statement: Recovered four published NatSec100 editions and their selected-company surfaces. The public pages expose selected cohorts and methodology statements, but not the complete preselection candidate universe required by the packet.
included_rows: published selected-company cohorts for 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026
published methodology and eligibility statements where exposed by the edition pages
excluded_rows: unpublished companies considered before selection
rejected, ineligible, withdrawn, and failed candidate rows
unavailable_rows: complete preselection candidate universe
exact formula weights for all inputs
FOCI reviewer custody and company-level vetting dispositions
formal appeal and correction outcomes
refused_rows: absence of a public candidate list is not treated as an empty denominator
ranking recurrence is not treated as procurement selection, relationship, or prevalence
packet_plans.negative_search_statement: Edition navigation and published methodology were checked; no complete candidate, rejected, or ineligible roster was exposed.
correction_route: Silicon Valley Defense Group methodology or contact channel
edition-level correction by the ranking publisher

nonprotesting bidders and offerors

packet_plans.coverage_statement: Recovered peer-reviewed status and hierarchy research and an independent demographic profile for the 2024 electorate. The records describe bounded populations, associations, and coalition composition; they do not define a complete institutional deservingness category, allocator, affected rows, consequence, or correction chain.

cross-dataset associations between hierarchy-related attitudes and non-White Trump support
Pew demographic composition of the 2024 Trump electorate
excluded_rows: individual voters outside the studied samples
institutional decision rows not identified by the source chain
unavailable_rows: complete deservingness-category denominator
bounded institutional gate and selector
affected rows, material consequence, burden, collective claim, and practical correction
refused_rows: research samples and electorate composition are not treated as a complete deservingness denominator
association is not treated as individual motive, racial order, common purpose, or institutional allocation
packet_plans.negative_search_statement: The source chain was checked for a bounded institutional gate and decision ledger; none was identified. The result remains a public-record research recovery rather than an institutional acquisition.
correction_route: election, independent research, protected dissent, and later gate-specific review once a gate is identified
